race.title: Jimmy & Sheila Owens Irish EBF Beginners Chase
race.verdict: This is often a very informative maiden chase and this year's looks no different. MIGHTY PARK was held back by inexperience in the Supreme following his demolition job on his Fairyhouse hurdling debut and looks one to follow over fences this season. He can get his chasing career off to the perfect start, perhaps at the expense of his stablemate Saint Baco , who could well be suited by the drop back in trip on first go over the larger obstacles. Largy Star and Bleu De Vassy also deserve mentions. MIGHTY PARK (IRE) SAINT BACO (FR) LARGY STAR (IRE)
